status: post-outcome generated structural preflight frozen before any collective-level 3D outcome is calculated
role: separate post-freeze mechanism extension; cannot modify or rescue the frozen JAE submission
biological_question: Does the archive contain enough cross-time, cross-individual structure to distinguish personal 3D persistence from a group-level spatial template?

preflight_information_firewall.note: Existing source parsers may require a finite height field to reproduce the previously frozen session universe, but this preflight does not summarize, bin, compare, score, or otherwise use height values.

shared_preprocessing.shifted_night_rule: median session timestamp minus 12 hours, then UTC calendar date

lane_A_natural_turnover.purpose: strict collective-persistence candidate using naturally non-overlapping tracked membership
lane_A_natural_turnover.interpretation_if_gate_passes: A later frozen outcome may test whether pooled 3D group shape persists across nights that share no tracked individual.
lane_A_natural_turnover.interpretation_if_gate_fails: The archive cannot directly test strict collective persistence under natural tracked-member turnover.

lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.purpose: hierarchical predictive decomposition without claiming collective memory
future_estimand_if_gate_passes: shared-group gain: other-individual past conditional 3D profile versus the same other-individual marginal vertical profile
personal increment: focal-individual past conditional 3D profile versus other-individual past conditional profile
total personal-history gain: focal-individual conditional profile versus other-individual marginal profile
lane_B_cross_individual_prediction.additive_identity: total_gain = shared_group_gain + personal_increment on the same scored target fixes

claim_boundary: Lane A can establish collective-level spatial persistence only descriptively; it cannot by itself identify social or cognitive memory because stable landscape structure is an alternative.
Lane B can establish a shared group template plus a personal residual if both predictive components are positive, but must not be relabelled colony memory.
No outcome threshold, lag, grid, support rule, panel universe, or membership rule may be changed after this preflight result is opened.
